Title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
Description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [Location|Name] and take you to visit [StoreName], a weapons store here in [Location|Name].

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

Title: Tutorial - Your First Steps
Description:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space. 

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

Title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
Description:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in [Location|Name] finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the [TransitNameShort] transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around [Location|Name] – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

Title: Salvager Needed (Small Special Order of RMC / Components)
Description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent special order, we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC) and components by stripping abandoned ships and removing the requested parts by hand with a <EM4>tractor beam</EM4>. 

We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points, maybe in one of Nyx's asteroid belts, or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager. We advise extra caution since there have been Vanduul sightings in the system, especially with how long it might take for you to track down this specific order.  

Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at <EM4>Levski</EM4>.

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship
     - A handheld tractor beam

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

Title: Disable Headhunter Comm Towers
Description:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and disable the communication towers. There should be a <EM4>control panel located at the top</EM4> of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Shutdown Xenothreat Comm Towers
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and find the towers. At the <EM4>top is a control panel</EM4> that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Patrol Risky Travel Lanes
Description:
We’ve noted an increase in traffic along one of the travel lanes we monitor. Chances are that we won’t be the only ones paying attention. I’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and make sure there are no outlaws attempting to take advantage of this sense of security.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip.</EM4>

Title: Intercepted Supply Run
Description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Assistance needed at ~mission(Location)
Description:
We received a distress call from [Location|Address] saying that they're being robbed by a small group of outlaws. [Location|CaveSize] Though remote, this outpost is a crucial piece of CFP's infrastructure in the area so we need to take it back.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
Description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination]</EM4>  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Establishing Security
Description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we are looking for anyone with combat experience to help secure <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that has been taken over by a group of outlaws.

We've tried to work with them but have only been met with violence and threats.

Once complete, we can offer you a variety of new job opportunities in this system and beyond.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: First Haul in System
Description:
Welcome to the system, not sure if you're familiar with our organization but Citizens for Prosperity are a non-profit organization dedicated to bringing security and civilization to unclaimed systems.

If you're looking for work in the system and would like to help achieve our goal, we need a package picked up from <EM4>Stanton Gateway</EM4> and taken to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Lima Endicott

Title: Recovering Valuable Supplies
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Defend ~mission(Location) from Outlaws
Description:
We learned that [Location|Address] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws. 

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Call for Help: ~mission(Location)
Description:
We've received a distress call from [Location|Address]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Raid to Recover Supplies
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaim Stolen Cargo
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at [Location|Address]. We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down [TargetName|First] on our behalf. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a mechanic who has performed countless services for our community, was abducted by a group of outlaws three standard days ago. CFP has received a ransom comm, but we refuse to negotiate with the types of people who actively work to destroy the peace in this system. If we open that door even once, we will never be safe. 

The outlaws known to have abducted [TargetName|Last]  were last seen entering [Location|Address]. CFP needs someone to infiltrate the base and confirm our missing person's whereabouts.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Citizens for Pyro is concerned about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been frequenting the area, so I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|Last] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of the system's missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
Description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Clear ~mission(Location) of Salvage
Description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location|Address], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Protection against ~mission(TargetName|Last)
Description:
Reports indicate that [Location|Address] has come under attack from a group of armed individuals led by a notorious outlaw named [TargetName]. There have been multiple reported deaths and injuries, so Citizens for Prosperity has been looking for qualified combat operatives to provide some support. 

Though we don't advocate conflict resolution through violence, we believe that the group will disperse if [TargetName|Last] is not there to lead them.

Head over as soon as you can. Lives are on the line.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to [Location|Address], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott

Title: Find Missing Cargo Hauler
Description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
Description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived. 

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate [Location|Address] to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: ~mission(Location|Address) needs help
Description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against [Location] by a large group of armed individuals led by [TargetName], a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that [TargetName|Last] tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
Description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Retrieve Supplies
Description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at [Destination|Address]. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find Lost Supply Ship
Description:
Hey,

I’m concerned a [Ship] moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around [Location|Address], which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to [Destination]. 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to [Destination|Address]. Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot in Distress
Description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
Description:
There is a group of outlaws at [Location|Address] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Assist Retreating Ship
Description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Protect CFP Members from Overactive Kopions
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity have approached us with information that multiple groups of kopions have been attacking people at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> without provocation. Currently, no deaths have been reported, but they are concerned their most vulnerable will be at risk if these kopions continue running rampant.

Ensure you are prepared adequately, kopions hunt in packs and it is easy to become overwhelmed by their sheer numbers.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
Description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [Location|Address] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at [Location|Address], but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
Description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Take Outlaws at ~mission(Location) Offline
Description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at [Location|Address] have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Minor Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
A nearby outpost of ours at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is suffering from some mechanical failures and could use repairing. Our usual technician is off on another job so we're looking to hire an outside contractor.

We will need <EM4>three fuses replaced</EM4> and if you could bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough canisters of RMC to fix around three pipes</EM4> that should take care of the rest.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Minor Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
Hi,

One of our outposts at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is in need of some light repairs. The folks onsite have estimated that you’ll need <EM4>three fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to fix up to three or so pipes.</EM4>

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks again for your help,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot in Distress
Description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Recover Cargo
Description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Description:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> with the required supplies and perform some repairs.

As it stands, you’ll need <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so.</EM4> That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Moderate Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes</EM4>, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

Title: Need a Hauler
Description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
Description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Recover Cargo
Description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.

Title: Investigate Missing Pilot and Cargo
Description:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, [TargetName], was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] to ascertain what has happened to [TargetName|First], destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to [Destination|Address].

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at [Location|Address] and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
An upstanding member of the Citizens for Prosperity community, Doctor [TargetName], was recently abducted by XenoThreat while distributing vital medical supplies to one of our settlements.

The kidnappers were last seen entering their base at [Location|Address], but we are uncertain whether they will remain there for long. XenoThreat maintains multiple outposts throughout this system and has been known to swap locations at a moment's notice. 

Considering the danger and the distance you may have to travel, CFP is prepared to offer a substantial reward for determining what happened to Dr. [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Regain Supplies from XenoThreat
Description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Call for Help: ~mission(Location)
Description:
We've received a distress call from [Location|Address]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Raid to Recover Supplies
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaim Stolen Cargo
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at [Location|Address]. We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down [TargetName|First] on our behalf. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a mechanic who has performed countless services for our community, was abducted by a group of outlaws three standard days ago. CFP has received a ransom comm, but we refuse to negotiate with the types of people who actively work to destroy the peace in this system. If we open that door even once, we will never be safe. 

The outlaws known to have abducted [TargetName|Last]  were last seen entering [Location|Address]. CFP needs someone to infiltrate the base and confirm our missing person's whereabouts.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Citizens for Pyro is concerned about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been frequenting the area, so I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|Last] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of the system's missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
Description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Clear ~mission(Location) of Salvage
Description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location|Address], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Defend ~mission(Location) from Outlaws
Description:
We learned that [Location|Address] is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws. 

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alert: ~mission(Location) under attack
Description:
We need any available security personnel to report to [Location|Address]. A group of armed individuals have attacked one of our outpost clusters and we're in desperate need of help. Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is [TargetName], a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Investigate Missing Pilot and Cargo
Description:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, [TargetName], was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] to ascertain what has happened to [TargetName|First], destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to [Destination|Address].

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Protect ~mission(Location) from XenoThreat Incursion
Description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe [Location|Address] off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaiming Clusters from Headhunters
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near [Location|Address] that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out [TargetName], who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Campaign to reclaim XenoThreat outposts
Description:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near [Location|Address] were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of [TargetName].

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out [TargetName|Last], who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Personnel and Data Captured by XenoThreat
Description:
One of our most trusted datarunners, [TargetName], has found themselves the victim of a XenoThreat assault. Now both they and the data they were ferrying have been captured and taken to [Location|Address]. 

I am charging you with heading there to ascertain what happened to [TargetName|First] and to destroy data servers which may be housing the stolen information.

Even if the worst has happened, I think they would want us to make sure they data they were charged with protecting isn't used for nefarious gains.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find ~mission(TargetName) and Missing Supplies
Description:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named [TargetName] who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at [Location|Address]. I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate [TargetName|First]? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to [Destination|Address]. I’ll give you the same warning I gave [TargetName|First], that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot. 

Be Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
Description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at [Location|Address] our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
An upstanding member of the Citizens for Prosperity community, Doctor [TargetName], was recently abducted by XenoThreat while distributing vital medical supplies to one of our settlements.

The kidnappers were last seen entering their base at [Location|Address], but we are uncertain whether they will remain there for long. XenoThreat maintains multiple outposts throughout this system and has been known to swap locations at a moment's notice. 

Considering the danger and the distance you may have to travel, CFP is prepared to offer a substantial reward for determining what happened to Dr. [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Regain Supplies from XenoThreat
Description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing Volunteers
Description:
Two of our volunteers vanished while on a recent foraging expedition. It has been over two standard days since their disappearance, and their families have begun to fear the worst and are willing to offer a reward if someone can help trace their whereabouts.

They were last seen in the vicinity of [Location|Address]. It is possible that they may have been injured and sought shelter in an abandoned building or a cave. The area is full of potential hiding spots, so your search will need to be thorough. 

Thank you for taking this on. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Kopion Culling for CFP
Description:
We’re putting out a contract for anyone who is capable of hunting animals responsibly. Citizens for Prosperity needs a group of aggressive kopions who have been harassing their people culled from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. After some initial monitoring, it looked as if they may on, but unfortunately we’ve been forced to take action. This is a relatively straightforward job, but when dealing with dangerous animals, cautious is always advised.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Overaggressive Kopions Need Removing
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity recently reported to us that one of their scouts was injured by kopions during a routine exploration mission. According to them, this isn't the first time this particular pack has posed a problem, so they've requested our services to clear out the area. The report shows they were last seen at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

This behavior is typical of kopions looking to expand their territory, so it is highly likely that you will be dealing with more kopions than initially observed. Caution is advised. 

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Attack on CFP outpost
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available combat operators to [Location|Address]. A group of outlaws have launched an unprovoked attack and our security personnel are desperately in need of support.

Please dispatch to [Location] with all urgency and good luck.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Defenders needed against Headhunters
Description:
We received an emergency comm from [Location|Address] reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Call for Help: ~mission(Location)
Description:
We've received a distress call from [Location|Address]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Protecting outpost from XenoThreat
Description:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near [Location|Address]. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support. 

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Raid to Recover Supplies
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaim Stolen Cargo
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at [Location|Address]. We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down [TargetName|First] on our behalf. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a mechanic who has performed countless services for our community, was abducted by a group of outlaws three standard days ago. CFP has received a ransom comm, but we refuse to negotiate with the types of people who actively work to destroy the peace in this system. If we open that door even once, we will never be safe. 

The outlaws known to have abducted [TargetName|Last]  were last seen entering [Location|Address]. CFP needs someone to infiltrate the base and confirm our missing person's whereabouts.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Citizens for Pyro is concerned about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been frequenting the area, so I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|Last] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of the system's missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
Description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location|Address], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [Location|Address] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find Missing Cargo Hauler
Description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
Description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived. 

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate [Location|Address] to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
Description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Retrieve Supplies
Description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at [Destination|Address]. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find Lost Supply Ship
Description:
Hey,

I’m concerned a [Ship] moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around [Location|Address], which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to [Destination]. 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to [Destination|Address]. Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot in Distress
Description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
Description:
There is a group of outlaws at [Location|Address] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Assist Retreating Ship
Description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We've received disturbing news: [TargetName], the scout that was reported missing last week has been seen in Headhunter custody. According to the witness, they were spotted being loaded into a transport headed to [Location|Address] this time yesterday. 

If anyone out there can confirm their whereabouts, there's a reward in store. Citizens for Prosperity maintains hope that they are alive and well. If not, their families deserve to know their fates either way. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
Description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near [Location|Address]. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.
