Description:
Hi,

One of our outposts at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is in need of some light repairs. The folks onsite have estimated that you’ll need <EM4>three fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to fix up to three or so pipes.</EM4>

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks again for your help,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Moderate Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> with the required supplies and perform some repairs.

As it stands, you’ll need <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so.</EM4> That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Moderate Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
Hello,

We've received word that a devastating storm hit <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> which caused some damage to the structures. Our technician on site is still trying to figure out what they can fix but they can’t get everything. If you bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to repair around five pipes</EM4>, we should be able to handle any remaining repairs.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Extensive Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Extensive Repairs Needed: ~mission(Location)
Description:
We need some help. The CFP facility at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> suffered severe damage during a recent electrical storm and we're looking for anyone who can help with repairs.

Surveying the site, you'll have to bring <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to take care of eight or so pipes</EM4>. That should be enough to repair the damage and get the outpost back in operation.

If you need more information on maintenance work, see <EM4>“Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> entry in your mobiGlas Journal.

Do you think you can help?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Need a Hauler
Description:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. To make your life easier, be sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
Description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Recover Cargo
Description:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to [Location|Address].

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Investigate Missing Pilot and Cargo
Description:
A local courier who has been working for Citizen for Prosperity, [TargetName], was reported missing earlier this week. We believe that they may have been captured by members of XenoThreat who were after the encrypted data-drives and important cargo they were transporting for us.  

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] to ascertain what has happened to [TargetName|First], destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to [Destination|Address].

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaim XenoThreat Outpost
Description:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted [Location|Address] and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
An upstanding member of the Citizens for Prosperity community, Doctor [TargetName], was recently abducted by XenoThreat while distributing vital medical supplies to one of our settlements.

The kidnappers were last seen entering their base at [Location|Address], but we are uncertain whether they will remain there for long. XenoThreat maintains multiple outposts throughout this system and has been known to swap locations at a moment's notice. 

Considering the danger and the distance you may have to travel, CFP is prepared to offer a substantial reward for determining what happened to Dr. [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Regain Supplies from XenoThreat
Description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing Volunteers
Description:
Two of our volunteers vanished while on a recent foraging expedition. It has been over two standard days since their disappearance, and their families have begun to fear the worst and are willing to offer a reward if someone can help trace their whereabouts.

They were last seen in the vicinity of [Location|Address]. It is possible that they may have been injured and sought shelter in an abandoned building or a cave. The area is full of potential hiding spots, so your search will need to be thorough. 

Thank you for taking this on. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Defenders needed against Headhunters
Description:
We received an emergency comm from [Location|Address] reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Call for Help: ~mission(Location)
Description:
We've received a distress call from [Location|Address]. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Protecting outpost from XenoThreat
Description:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near [Location|Address]. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support. 

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Raid to Recover Supplies
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws in the system have been getting aggressive lately, targeting more of our convoys. They recently ambushed one of our cargo ships and stole supplies desperately needed by our operations. If we don’t get it back, we’re worried that the locals will start losing faith. They need to know that Citizens for Prosperity can’t just be bullied out of operation.

We managed to track the outlaws to [Location|Address]. Now we need someone who isn’t afraid of crossing these criminals to recover the shipment and deliver it to [Destination|Address]. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

So, do you think you could make the run for us?

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaim Stolen Cargo
Description:
Hey,

Outlaws used a fake distress beacon to lure one of our cargo ships into a trap and steal the supplies onboard. Thankfully, we placed trackers in the cargo containers, because the stuff is valuable mining and construction materials needed at [Destination]. 

Looks like the goods ended up at [Location|Address]. Need someone to head there, reclaim the supplies, and take them to [Destination|Address]. Doubt they’ll make it easy for you, but if it helps, they didn’t show any mercy to our ship crew. Reclaiming those supplies will not only help the CFP but ensure that our crew didn’t die in vain.   

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName], a member of the Citizens for Prosperity family, vanished two standard days ago while attempting to find a buyer for some old farming equipment. CFP regrets to report that we have just discovered the wreckage of a vehicle registered under the name of the missing person in an area known to be frequented by pirates. 

We found evidence at the crash site that the victim survived and is most likely being held at [Location|Address]. We are offering a reward to anyone who can track down [TargetName|First] on our behalf. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find ~mission(TargetName|Last)
Description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TargetName]. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction [Location|Address]. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Citizens for Pyro is concerned about one of our local contractors, [TargetName]. They finished up a trade at [Location|Address] and haven’t been seen since. We’re hearing reports that outlaws have been frequenting the area, so I suspect that the worst might have happened.

Either way, [TargetName|Last] has done good work for us in the past and I’d hate for them to wind up as just another one of the system's missing. If you’re willing to find them for me, I’ll see that you get a reward.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
Description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at [Location|Address] and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Clear ~mission(Location) of Salvage
Description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location|Address], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Clear ~mission(Location) of Salvage
Description:
Hi,

A repair crew has been making some much needed changes and upgrades to our outposts. After finishing some work at [Location|Address], they've set aside some scrap they didn’t have time to deal with. 

Looking to hire someone to go there and salvage it so it’s out of the way. Should be a quick clean up if you’re interested. Any RMC is yours to keep.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Junior surveyor [TargetName] fell out of contact with their team while identifying potentially viable mineral seams in a cave near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Wild animals have been known to frequent this location, which has led Citizens for Prosperity to believe that the surveyor may have been attacked while on the job and is currently stranded. 

We need someone to find them and render aid if at all possible. If it's too late and they're beyond help, it will at least comfort the rest of the team to know what happened to their friend. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
[TargetName] is a local who only has done a few jobs for Citizen for Prosperity, but they had promise. That is, until they went missing while exploring [Location|Address] last week. Unfortunately, we didn’t hear about it until today. Chances of survival at this point are pretty slim, but we still think its worth confirming what happened to them.
 
CFP could use help on this if anyone is interested. And besides being a good deed, the payment should make it worth the effort. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
One of our people, [TargetName], was supposed to be doing some preliminary scouting work over at [Location|Address], but they never reported in. We’re hoping that they just ran into some bad luck, but too often out here even the smallest misstep can prove fatal.

I’d appreciate someone heading that way and seeing if they can be located. It’d be great if you find them alive, but if not, some closure is the least we can do for their family.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
Description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to [Location|Address] and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Last night, the homesteader [TargetName] was abducted by Headhunters for unknown reasons. Citizens for Prosperity has not received a ransom note, nor has the victim's family. However, we have just received word from an informant that the abducted party was most likely taken to [Location|Address]. 

We need someone to determine the validity of this information, and to report back to CFP. A reward will be provided whether your findings are good or bad. 

You may need to utilize a ground vehicle to help you search the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Eradicate All Traces of Headhunter Data
Description:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of [TargetName] recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause. 

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at [Location|Address] as well as tracking down [TargetName|Last] to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find Missing Cargo Hauler
Description:
Hey, 

One of our veteran haulers got sick and backed out of a run that we desperately needed. [TargetName] stepped up and offered to do it. I was hesitant to give it to ‘em because it’s riskier than the routes they normally do. Seems like my concern was warranted. Last update we got from ‘em was near [Location|Address], which is XenoThreat territory.

Can’t have this hanging over my head much longer. Any chance you’d be willing to head to their last known location and see if you can find out what happened? It’d mean a lot to me and others. Not only to know the status of [TargetName] but also the cargo, which is really needed at [Destination|Address]. If you find it and complete the delivery, it would be a huge help to the CFP members there.   

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find XenoThreat Captives and Stolen Data
Description:
A small group of Citizens for Prosperity members were supposed to be delivering sensitive data back to our headquarters in Stanton, but they never arrived. 

We now believe that they were captured by XenoThreat before they could leave the system. I'd like you to investigate [Location|Address] to discover what happened to the missing crew and then destroy any servers they could be using to store the stolen data.

Your help is very appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Unfortunately, one of our community partners, [TargetName], has been missing for a few days. Their family contacted Citizens for Prosperity for help and I told them we would do what we could. That said, with so much time passed, I’m not too hopeful.

Whatever their current state is, we're looking for someone to be our eyes on the ground for this one. There’s a strong chance that they were headed to [Location|Address], an area known to be very dangerous.

If you can track them down and confirm their status, one way or another, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
Description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Retrieve Supplies
Description:
Hi,

It appears an electrical issue caused us to lose track of a [Ship] carrying medical supplies. Thankfully, I received word that the ship was found at [Location|Address]. We really need someone to get out there and recover the supplies onboard before someone else does. Those provisions are desperately needed at [Destination|Address]. Any chance you could grab them and complete the delivery? 

Makes me nervous seeing that the ship is at a lagrange point. Lots of folks scour them for stuff like this. Would be smart to come prepared to defend yourself if someone else comes looking to steal it.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you.    

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Find Lost Supply Ship
Description:
Hey,

I’m concerned a [Ship] moving medical supplies for us might’ve come under attack. The signal was lost around [Location|Address], which has seen a spike in outlaw activity recently. Losing that ship alone would be bad enough, but it’ll be even worse if those supplies don’t make it to [Destination]. 

We would need you to search for the ship at its last known position, recover the supplies, and then take them to [Destination|Address]. Your help would make a bad situation better. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot in Distress
Description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
Description:
There is a group of outlaws at [Location|Address] that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Assist Retreating Ship
Description:
One of our people is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away. 

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
Description:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near The cave can only be accessed on foot.. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We’ve been trying to get in contact with community member [TargetName], but haven’t heard from them in a few days. From what Citizens for Prosperity has been able to find out, they were scouting out near The cave can only be accessed on foot. which is a known outlaw hotspot.

We need someone to go there for us and try to locate them, or worst case scenario, their remains. 

If you are able to find them, there’s a reward on offer.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Two locals we work with were out salvaging at [Location|Address] when they had some issues with faulty equipment. One managed to escape, but their partner, [TargetName] was unfortunately left behind.

With the state they were last reported to be in, I’m guessing they didn’t make it, but I’d like to know for sure. If you’re willing, I could use your help in finding their remains.

If you can track them down, I’ll see that you’re properly compensated for the effort.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot in Distress
Description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support.

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location|Address]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination|Address]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

We would like you to go to [Location|Address] to ascertain what has happened to [TargetName|First], destroy any servers which may be housing the stolen data,  and deliver the recovered cargo to [Destination|Address].

It's a lot to ask, but I believe you're up to the challenge.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
An upstanding member of the Citizens for Prosperity community, Doctor [TargetName], was recently abducted by XenoThreat while distributing vital medical supplies to one of our settlements.

The kidnappers were last seen entering their base at [Location|Address], but we are uncertain whether they will remain there for long. XenoThreat maintains multiple outposts throughout this system and has been known to swap locations at a moment's notice. 

Considering the danger and the distance you may have to travel, CFP is prepared to offer a substantial reward for determining what happened to Dr. [TargetName|Last].

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Regain Supplies from XenoThreat
Description:
Hey,

One of our supply ships fell prey to a XenoThreat ambush. I’ll spare you the grisly details, but all that really remains is the cargo our people were carrying to [Destination|Address]. Trackers hidden within the cargo shows that XenoThreat collected the goods and then took them to a few locations spread out across [Location|Address].
 
We can’t let the XenoThreat get away with what they did to our crew and keep all those goods too. That’s why we want to strike back on both fronts. We need someone who can raid that location, retrieve the stolen cargo, and teach the Xenos that there will be consequences for their horrendous actions. Can you help us fight back?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Missing: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
During what should have been a routine cargo run, hauler and long-time friend of Citizens for Prosperity [TargetName] was ambushed and abducted by XenoThreat. The coded distress signal we received from the victim just before their comms went dark gave us just enough information to pinpoint their most likely location: [Location|Address].

CFP needs someone to slip into the outpost, confirm the whereabouts of [TargetName|Last], and relay this information back to us so we know exactly where to send our rescue team. Or, in the worst possible scenario, deliver news to the hauler's family that their loved one didn't survive. 

We understand how dangerous it is to approach a XenoThreat stronghold, and are prepared to offer a sizeable reward for putting yourself at risk.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
Description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at [Location|Address].

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at ~mission(Destination)
Description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at ~mission(Destination)
Description:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Special Recovery Operation
Description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Intercepted Supply Run
Description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
Description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Reclaim Headhunter Outpost
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for security personnel to take a former CFP outpost that's currently serving as a hideout for Headhunters to launch attacks throughout the system. 

Located near [Location|Address], reclaiming this outpost will allow CFP to provide greater support to local efforts to build stability.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Clear CFP Route of Hostiles
Description:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.

You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [Location|Address] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
Description:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to [Location|Address] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Remove Upstart Gang From Sector
Description:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out [Location|Address] only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises. 

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party
Description:
Recently we've had incident reports of numerous Citizens for Prosperity contractors in the system having run-ins with an outlaw hunting party operating out of [Location|Address]. 

To help re-establish safer routes through that sector, you will be dispatched to head there and engage with these outlaws. The group is known to travel in smaller packs, so its important that you and whatever backup you bring wait in the area to deal with all of them or else there's a chance the threat will remain. 

Thank you for helping us,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
Description:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near [Location|Address] when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers. 

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Convoy Caught in Brutal Attack
Description:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance. 

If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at [Location|Address] to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Seeking Experienced Combat Pilots
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try. 

A civilian ship has requested combat support near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.  

Please be aware. This mission is not a training exercise. This is a real encounter, so please do your best to save the ship in distress. 

Good Luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [Location|Address] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers. 

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Come to Aid of Convoy
Description:
I’m getting reports that a Citizens for Prosperity convoy carrying vital supplies is currently under attack at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. It’d be a big blow to our operations if we lost that cargo. 

If you’ve got the combat skills to go up against highly aggressive hostiles, we’re more than willing to pay for your help. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Pilot in Distress
Description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at [Location|Address] and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Respond to Distress Beacon
Description:
A Citizens for Prosperity convoy on a resupply run dropped a distress beacon near <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They’re not answering any comms, so I assume the situation is serious. That convoy has some skilled pilots, so if they’re not responding then they definitely need the help.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.  

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Medical Cargo Haul - Large Scale
Description:
Hello,

With the ongoing emergency in Levski, Alliance Aid needs all hands on deck to help transport enough medical supplies to save as many lives as possible. There's a large scale haul over at <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4> ready to be brought to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This run needs a hauler with a ship that can hold <EM4>8 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. You'll also need a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to deal with the crates.    

Please let me know if you can handle this for us.   

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Large Cargo Haul (Medical)
Description:
Hi,

The outbreak of the People’s Ailment from Molina Mold has put a strain on the availability of medical supplies. Got a priority, large scale run here to get <EM4>Levski</EM4> restocked with necessary pharmaceuticals and equipment. Any chance you’re available?

Pick up for this haul is at <EM4>Port Tressler</EM4>. You’ll be dealing with containers that are up to <EM4>8 SCU</EM4> in size. Be sure to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, and a ship that can fit containers that size. 

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Large Cargo Haul (Research)
Description:
Hey,

A special containment team at <EM4>Levski</EM4> has collected and securely packaged enough Molina mold samples for a large scale haul. Researchers at <EM4>Port Tressler</EM4> are eagerly awaiting its arrival so they can continue their tests. Any chance you can do this run for us?

I've confirmed with the containment team that they used biohazard-grade containers, so there's no risk of you catching the People's Aliment. Just bring a ship that can haul <EM4>16 SCU</EM4> cargo containers and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>.

Hope its a safe and smooth haul for you,

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Title: Alliance Aid: Treatment Cargo Haul - Large Scale
Description:
Hi,

People are breathing a sigh of relief that a treatment for the People's Aliment has been found, but we're not out of the woods just yet. There's still plenty of folks suffering . We're hoping you can help the cause by handling a large scale haul of the stuff.  

If you're available, we need you to pick up from <EM4>NB Int. Spaceport</EM4> and then fly it over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>16 SCU cargo containers</EM4>. 
 

Safe Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Title: Alliance Aid: Collect Manufacturing Resource - Large Scale
Description:
POSTING: Resource Gathering 
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is stepping up to help stop the spread of the People’s Ailment. Our facilities are helping in the efforts to produce much needed ventilation filters to replace the faulty ones responsible for the spread of the dangerous Molina Mold, but we need your help to hit that ambitious goal. 

Our current stockpiles of an important resource are not sufficient enough, so we need contractors who can deliver a large-scale haul of it to <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4>.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.   

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Title: Alliance Aid: Interstellar Large Cargo Haul (Filters)
Description:
Hey,

Help us put an end to the People's Affliction by hauling new vent filters to places that need replacements. 

Here's a run of them from <EM4>Everus Harbor</EM4> to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. This is a large scale haul, so bring a ship that can fit everything. The manifest also specifies that that largest container you'll be dealing with is <EM4>16 SCU</EM4>. Would strongly recommending bringing a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to deal with those. 

Thanks for joining us and Alliance Aid to help bring this crisis to an end!

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping  
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Title: Alliance Aid: Vital Package Retrieval
Description:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid has not completed it's contract. The last known location has it still over at <EM4>Glaciem Ring Wreck Site</EM4>. A courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to <EM4>Levski</EM4>. 

THREAT LEVEL – It is unclear what happened to the ship, but we expect a malfunction. Still, caution is advised. <EM4>Low level engagements</EM4> expected.

TRAVEL –  All transportation needs should be arranged by courier. 

FTL Courier Services is proud to be assisting in Alliance Aid efforts to help fight the Levski outbreak.

Title: Alliance Aid: Ship in Trouble
Description:
We’ve lost contact with an Alliance Aid supply convoy and are concerned it might be under attack from outlaws. We need you to hurry to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and support them. Any delays to the ongoing relief efforts could cost lives in Levski.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Ship Under Attack
Description:
Everyone has been joining with Alliance Aid to help with the ongoing crisis in Levski, but it seems you can't do good in this 'verse without attracting the bad. One of the critical relief convoys was just attacked by a powerful outlaw fleet. We need you to <EM4>put together a fleet of your own</EM4> and deploy to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> as soon as possible. With any luck, you may be able to right this wrong before it's too late.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Ship in Distress
Description:
You figure these outlaws would have the decency not to interfere with relief efforts but unfortunately we've gotten word that an Alliance Aid convoy is under attack. These criminals seem to be a serious threat so it would be recommended to <EM4>bring some support along</EM4> with you. 

Once you're ready, head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and face these criminals head on.


Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Escort Needed
Description:
Citizens for Prosperity need a combat-experienced pilot to provide extra support to an Alliance Aid pilot who is making a vital trip from <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> for the ongoing relief effort. 

Outlaws have been launching more attacks thanks to the increased activity brought on by the Molina Mold outbreak, so it’ll be your job to make sure that they stay safe while they’re completing their work. This route is relatively safe, so I'm not expecting too much trouble, but its better not to take the risk.

If you’re interested, you’ll rendezvous there and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Protection Detail Needed
Description:
Alliance Aid has a ship vital to the relief effort leaving from <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. They have received credible threats that they may be attacked and are looking to bring on additional security.

When you're ready, head to the rendezvous with yourself and <EM4>any additional combat ships you can recruit</EM4>  and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Security Needed
Description:
I was just contacted by an Alliance Aid rep who is deeply concerned for one of their contractors heading out from  <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. The ships helping the relief effort have been drawing a lot of outlaw attention and they're worried that without extra protection they won't be able to finish their vital work.  

Owing with the increased risk level and the value of the ship, it might behoove you to <EM4>bring some combat support</EM4> of your own along.

If you’re interested, head to the rendezvous and await further instructions.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Alliance Aid: Supply Thief
Description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Neutralize Ship 
APPROVAL CODE = RT-04

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

With valuable shipments being transported to Levski thanks to this whole Alliance Aid thing, outlaws have been happy as clams targeting the loaded-up haulers. One particular scumbag, <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, has hit a half-dozen ships so far and everyone's pretty eager to stop their spree in its tracks.

They were last spotted harrassing ships over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Head there and take out their ship. Payment will be issued once they're neutralized. 

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Title: Alliance Aid: Hauler Hunters
Description:

Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
Description:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

Title: Taking Back Our Goods
Description:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

-Twitch

Title: Retrieval Op
Description:
You got a ship and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

Title: Lost But Not Gone
Description:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

Title: Finishing The Job
Description:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

Title: Finishing The Job
Description:
We got a situation. Some gang that no one’s heard of are trying to make a name for themselves by targeting our transport ships. They think they can make a big show of how tough they are raiding our haulers and acting like they’re big shots. Amateurs.

Problem is, they got lucky during their last attack. Our pilot barely made it out alive, but their ship is still sitting full of supplies over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Grab a crew you can trust and your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and get your ass over there.

After, drop the gear off at the freight elevator in <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. You do this for me and I’ll give you a good cut of the sale.

-Twitch

Title: Client's Cargo Needs Recovering
Description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Client's cargo was mid-transport when they ran into some ship trouble, and now a group of opportunistic outlaws are looking to cash in on this.

If you accept, head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and deal with the outlaws guarding the cargo. Extract it using a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, recover the cargo, load it in to a ship that can transport <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, and deposit it on the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Title: High Risk Shipment Recovery
Description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a transport in need of backup over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Signal was patchy, but their comms made it sound like a group of outlaws had gotten wind of what they were hauling and attempted to take it from them.

Considering the state of things before we lost contact, I'm considering this a recovery mission. Multiple hostiles are expected at the site, so a skilled crew is crucial for the success of this operation. There will be a high volume of cargo to deal with, so a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> will be needed. 

Upon successful extraction of cargo, deliver to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Title: Standard Cargo Recovery Op.
Description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can salvage a messy situation. A client's trusted pilot apparently wasn't so trustworthy and made off with a shipment. But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.

The abandoned ship is located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and will need a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the goods. A ship that can handle <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4> is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to. 

Once recovered, deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Title: Extreme Risk Cargo Retrieval
Description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Putting out an immediate call for a highly skilled contractor to reclaim a client's cargo located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>.

Client hired an expert hauler to transport something discreetly, but it seems some information regarding the shipment was either hacked or leaked. Title: Strategic Detatrine Reserve – Small Resupply
Description:
Following the brutal attack on Pyro and our efforts to combat the vigilante group the Frontier Fighters, our strategic reserves across the system are at an all-time low. Citizens for Prosperity are eager to replenish our stocks before we reach a point of desperation. 

To that end, we were hoping that you would be able to resupply<EM4> [Destination|Address] with detatrine. </EM4>

This rare chemical compound is a key ingredient in several vital medical supplies, so it is important that replace what we used up treating local civilians and CFP members injured in the wake of the Frontier Fighter assault.

Normally we would direct you to reputable sources to acquire detatrine, but our contacts have informed us that several <EM4>depots</EM4> around the system have suddenly decided to sell the chemical at a significantly reduced price. In fact, it’s inexpensive enough that I suspect it will draw some unwanted attention. If you decide to seek out this potentially deadly deal, please do so with caution.

Your support of our efforts is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Title: Out of Detatrine – Small Resupply
Description:
Kicking the crap out of those Frontier Fighter bastards seriously depleted our supplies and now our stash of detatrine is practically out of stock. 

That’s why you’re going to do a detatrine resupply run to<EM4> [Destination|Address]. </EM4>

Not sure if you’re familiar with it, but the chemical’s what we use to make our batches of sludge. We can’t really afford to let our sales of the stuff dry up right now. Not when we need credits so bad.

The good news is that <EM4>depots</EM4> across the system are offering detatrine and rock-bottom prices. Hell if I know why they’re doing it, all I know is that everyone with a lick of sense is trying to get their hands on the stuff so be ready for fierce competition. 

I’m trustin’ you to get it done,
Stows

Title: Red Level Contract: Clear PAFs, Recover Cargo, and Deliver to OLP
Description:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4> and <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>, but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. 

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
Description:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing. 

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. <EM4>The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.</EM4>

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly    


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL 
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #2
Description:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.   

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #3
Description:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.   

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.      

Whenever you’re ready, head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
Description:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.    

Make your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
Description:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.   

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.   

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire. 
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL  
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
Description:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.      

Find your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>. 

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located. 

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
Description:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.   

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.    

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly     


ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL   
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #8
Description:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of <EM4>[ScripAmount] MG Scrip</EM4>.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there, 
Instructor Gilly

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE SIZED HAUL
Description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
