Once mined, we would recommend refining at <EM4>CRU-L1’s Ambitious Dream Station</EM4> as it is near our drop off facility, however any refinery will suffice.

The refined ore can be delivered directly to a freight elevator at: <EM4>Orison</EM4>. Just submit this contract when you’re satisfied with the amount of resources delivered.

If you're an inexperienced miner but still would like to contribute, consider looking at URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal for support.

As a reminder, each company is required to publicly disclose their contributions. You can track this information, including who is leading in the initiative, under the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. As an incentive, Crusader will grant additional rewards when you’ve satisfied delivery thresholds.

Thank you for helping Crusader make a difference.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: CARGO HAULER NEEDED
Description:
In response to the ongoing regen crisis, Imperator Addison has just announced the Second Life initiative, a coordinated government-led effort to find a solution as quickly as possible.

As part of that initiative, Crusader Industries and the other governing corporations of the Stanton system have been asked to contribute towards this important endeavor by gathering vital resources, with incentives and rewards being offered to the corporation that provides the most SCU of materials.

To win, we need hardworking, effective people like yourself to complete contracts for us. To get you started, we were hoping you could transport a shipment of the sought-after materials. Once you have completed this, we will be able to offer you a variety of work to further support us.

You will need a ship that can handle <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4>. Once you’re ready, please head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, collect the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>Orison</EM4>.

In the interest of fair competition, each company is required to publicly disclose their contributions. You can track this information, including who is leading in the competition, under the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. Those who personally contribute significant efforts to Crusader’s totals will be eligible to receive additional rewards.

With your help, I know Crusader can make a difference.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: BRING US MATERIALS
Description:
ArcCorp is still competing for top spot in the resource race, so we need reliable contractors like you to supply us with refined materials. Unsurprisingly, every shop is completely sold out of these, but luckily we’ve got a list of suggestions where to mine them along with what you'll earn:

- <EM4>Copper</EM4> (surface of Aberdeen) - <EM4>803 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> (surface of Lyria) - <EM4>1080 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Corundum</EM4> (surface of ArcCorp) - <EM4>810 aUEC</EM4> per SCU

Make sure you get them refined before you hand them over, otherwise you’ll just make more work for us. <EM4>ARC-L1 Wide Forest Station</EM4> is a good option, but we don’t mind where you go so long as it gets done. Then, all you have to do is take the refined materials to a freight elevator at: <EM4>Area18</EM4>. Oh, and make sure to submit the contract when you’re happy with the total amount you delivered.

If you haven't mined in a while, I suggest taking a look at URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. That should give you a few pointers.

And just so you know, each company has to declare publicly how much they’ve given to the cause. You can track this information, including who is leading in the initiative, in the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> Journal entry. ArcCorp have very generously agreed to give out additional rewards when contractors meet certain delivery thresholds. How nice is that?

Good luck and talk soon!


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: DELIVER MATERIAL DONATION
Description:
ArcCorp needs your help.

Under Imperator Addison’s new Second Life initiative, they’ve introduced a government program that will reward whichever company gathers the most resources to help with the regen crisis. ArcCorp is eager to win, and to do that we need plenty of reliable and dependable contractors.

If you can knock out this easy hauling job and show you’re competent, then I can start offering you some more complicated work next.

For this job, you’ll need a ship that can take <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4>. Once you’re ready, head over to <EM4>ArcCorp Mining Area 045</EM4>, grab the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>Area18</EM4>. Easy, right?

If you want to keep track of how ArcCorp is stacking up against the competition, you can go to the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. If you do really well and help us get to the top, I’ve been given permission by my superiors at ArcCorp to reward the hardest working contractors with some extra stuff on top of whatever credits you earn.

Come work for ArcCorp and be part of the winning team.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: ONGOING MATERIAL ACQUISITION
Description:
We really appreciate all that you’ve done so far, but we’re still seeking additional resources to help secure our position in the Second Life initiative.

If you have any of the refined materials listed below, please deliver them to us. I doubt you’ll be able to find these in commodity markets at the moment, so we’ve attached a list of suggestions as to where these important resources can be extracted from and the price you'll receive:

- <EM4>Copper</EM4> (surface of Euterpe) - <EM4>803 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Tungsten</EM4> (surface of Wala) - <EM4>1080 aUEC</EM4> per SCU
- <EM4>Corundum</EM4> (surface of microTech) - <EM4>810 aUEC</EM4> per SCU

Ensure you refine the ore before bringing them to us. This can be done at the conveniently located <EM4>MIC-L1 Shallow Frontier Station</EM4>. Then you can deliver it to a freight elevator at: <EM4>New Babbage</EM4>.

Should you need assistance with mining, URW's <EM4>“The Fundamentals of Mining”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal provides a basic overview of the process.

You’ll find all the details of the Second Life initiative, including the other corporation’s standing in the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your Journal. As an extra incentive, microTech will provide bonuses to contractors who meet productivity goals.

Let’s get to work,


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: TRANSPORTER NEEDED
Description:
Here at microTech, we are committed to supporting the Empire and its people through these turbulent times. That’s why we’re delighted to announce that we will be participating in Imperator Addison’s Second Life initiative and competing side by side with the other corporations of Stanton to provide the resources needed to end the regen crisis once and for all.

We’re looking for highly skilled contractors that can help support us in our work. If you believe you’re able to do this, we would welcome you to complete this preliminary hauling contract before providing you with additional work.

You will need a ship able to transport <EM4>1 SCU cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment</EM4> for this delivery. The shipment is waiting to be collected from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and should be delivered to a freight elevator at: <EM4>New Babbage</EM4>.

The public declaration of each corporation's donations is a key part of this initiative. To access this information, please consult the <EM4>Second Life Resource Drive</EM4> section of your mobiGlas Journal. As an added reward, microTech will provide bonuses to contractors who meet productivity goals.

Let’s work together for the betterment of Humanity.


Aster Remmington
Contractor Liaison Officer
microTech

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE VESSEL UNDER ATTACK
Description:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Resource Drive
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: A. Carmichael
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

One of our transporters is currently under attack at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Normally, the loss in cargo wouldn’t be worth the expense of hiring combat support, but they’re carrying a significant amount of mining materials that Hurston needs.

I need someone who can go and defend the transport ship <EM4>until they're able to complete repairs and escape</EM4>. Do not underestimate these outlaws, <EM4>bring combat support to not make a bad situation worse</EM4>. Assist with this, and I’ll see you get credit for their delivery.

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: DEFEND LARGE CARGO SHIP
Description:
Putting out an urgent call to all trusted contractors.

One of our large hauling ships transporting resources intended for the Second Life Initiative is currently under attack by a group of outlaws and needs help.

The ship has sustained some damage, but they’re holding on for now. We need a contractor with combat experience who can <EM4>defend them long enough to allow them to get their quantum system back online and escape</EM4>.

Our system was tracking them to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> before we lost contact so I would start there. Due to the presence of a sizeable hostile force, we also <EM4>strongly advise bringing combat support with you</EM4>.

We’re desperate for help on this. If they’re able to complete their delivery, I’ll make sure you get credit for whatever SCU they drop off.


Denver Samuels
Contractor Liaison Officer
Crusader Industries

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE CARGO SHIP NEEDS HELP
Description:
Outlaws have hit an ArcCorp transport ship over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and they need urgent help defending it.

The cargo aboard is of vital importance to our standing in the Second Life resource drive, and we can’t afford to lose it. The captain and crew said they’re doing their best to hang on and get their quantum drive repaired, but honestly, I don’t think they have a chance at escaping unless they get some help. If they do make it back in one piece, I’ll make sure you get shared credit for the delivery.

Don’t underestimate these outlaws. <EM4>Bring as much firepower as you got and some backup</EM4> if you can.


Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE SHIP UNDER ATTACK
Description:
This one is urgent. A transport ship of ours is currently under attack. They were able to share their last known location of <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> shortly before losing contact.

Since this is a high-risk situation, <EM4>we strongly suggest you bring backup</EM4>. I have every confidence that you and your crew will be able to <EM4>occupy the outlaws long enough for the ship to complete repairs and escape with its cargo</EM4>.

Outside of the contract’s payment, you’ll receive credit for the resources they deliver.

Looking forward to hearing of your success.


Aster Remmington

microTech

Crusader Industries

Gotta go,


Ella Tieno

ArcCorp

Title: RESOURCE DRIVE: SMALL SHIP UNDER ATTACK
Description:

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

All you need to do is bring a ship with space for <EM4>24 SCU cargo containers</EM4>, a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, and be ready to do some damage if someone picks a fight with you.

Title: No Fly Zone
Description:
Some competition has taken root at [Location|Address] and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

Title: Wasting Their Stockpile
Description:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

Title: Stopping the Competition
Description: Stopping the Competition

Title: Outsmarting our Enemies
Description:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.

But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.

Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.

-Stows out

Title: Ground The Upstarts
Description:

Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out

Title: Trapping a Rat

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto. 

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

Title: Protect Our Site
Description:
Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4>. Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

Title: Help Headhunters at ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation)
Description:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops. 

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.  

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.  

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

Title: Secure Our Airspace
Description:
Our airspace around <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed. 
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

Title: Restore Order at ~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation)
Description:
Our crew at <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised. 

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

Title: Eliminate Annoyance
Description:
Headhunters flying in and out of <EM4>[DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address]</EM4> are being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. Need them dealt with before they become a real pain in the ass.   

Get there and I’ll update you on what these pests are doing so you can hunt ‘em down. 

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows

Title: ~mission(Contractor|PrisonerBreakTitle)
Description: Tecia Pacheco

Title: Taking what’s ours
Description:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.

Title: Jackpot
Description:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.

Title: Finish the job
Description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

Title: Worth the trouble
Description:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.

If you can get your best pilots together and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.  

I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send you the creds.

Stows out.

Title: Grab ‘n’ go
Description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

Title: Getting what we deserve
Description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

Title: Deliver a Message
Description:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. 

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us. 


Stows out.

Title: Show Them Who's Boss
Description:
Word’s gotten out that we’re expanding into Stanton and a local crew has hit a few of our safe houses. We managed to track the bastards back to some old Hathor mining site. 

You up for showing them how the Headhunters handle things? If so, head over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and show them that we mean business. 

 
- Stows

Title: Ghost ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves. 

Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is <EM4>[TargetName]</EM4>, who we’ve tracked to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Feel like ghosting ‘em?   

These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.

- Stows

Title: Scout and Scan
Description:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go. 

This one kicks off at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as a thanks.

Stows out.

Title: Looking For Trouble
Description:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there? 

The route starts at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to <EM4>bring a friend</EM4> to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 

- Stows

Title: Space Patrol
Description:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available? 

All you need to do is head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it. 

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> as thanks. 


Stows out.

Title: Hunt Some Heads
Description:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.  

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor that pulls it off. 

- Stows

Title: See What’s Out There
Description:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on. 

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

- Stows

Title: Stand Our Ground
Description:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.

We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off? 

If so, start by seeing what’s around the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing <EM4>two friends</EM4> to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4>. 

Stows out.

Title: Taking what’s ours
Description:
Managed to intercept a ship carrying some goods over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> but we hit a snag - our guys didn’t have enough space in their ships to store it. You wanna make some quick creds? Head over there and grab the stuff. Could be a few scavs there by now so be on your guard.

Just don’t forget to bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.

Title: Jackpot
Description:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>, I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.

Title: Finish the job
Description:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

Title: Worth the trouble
Description:
This’ll be a fun one for you. We just got word that a transport ship has broken down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Only problem is, every skag and their mother seems to know about it. Place is crawling with all kinds of outlaws trying to get their hands on the cargo onboard. That’s where you come in.

If you can get your best pilots together and <EM4>a heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> you can take out the competition and snag the cargo. It ain’t gonna be easy though. One of my scouts said the assholes guarding this ship have got some serious tech on them.  

I’ve already got a buyer waiting, you just need to take the cargo to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll send you the creds.

Stows out.

Title: Grab ‘n’ go
Description:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at [Destination|Address] and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

Title: Getting what we deserve
Description:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

Title: Silent Strike
Description:
Any interest in taking out a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> for us? 

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.  

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

Title: Reprisal Attack
Description:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.  

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right. 

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

Title: Setting a Trap
Description:
Got an opportunity for someone eager to show off their flying skills. Headhunters have been running afoul of this numbrain flying a<EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4> and we’re gonna put a stop to it once and for all.

You’re gonna help us set a trap for them. See, there’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4> that they fly by frequently. 

Head there, hide inside the cloud by powering down your ship, and attack the asshole as soon as you see ‘em and other single-seaters dumb enough to fly with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job. 

And in honor of this being your first surprise attack for us, there's a bonus of <EM4>[ScripAmount] Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor at the end of the job. 

Stows out.

Title: Ambush Op
Description:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a <EM4>[AmbushTarget]</EM4>. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus <EM4>[ScripAmount]</EM4> Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

Title: Shutdown CFP’s Comms
Description:
CFP think they’re safe over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a <EM4>control terminal at the top</EM4> that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.


Stows out.

Title: Silence the Xenothreat
Description:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and climb the comm towers there. Should be a <EM4>control panel at the top</EM4> you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.


Stows out.

Title: Cargo Retrieval
Description:
Need someone to snag some cargo for us. We were using an old Hathor PAF for dead drops, but a local gang has dug in and we can’t get our shit.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>. 

From what I’ve heard this place is full of all sorts. Won’t be easy getting out stuff back, but that’s what we’re paying you for.

Just make sure you got a ship that can handle a <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> load, and try not to get shot in the process. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Title: Stock Taking
Description:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. 

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4>, then we can sort your payment. 

A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Title: Getting Our Goods Back
Description:
We’ve been using the old Hathor <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4> and <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4> as stashes, but it turns out some over-eager nullbrains sniffed them out and are trying to boost our shit for their own.

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>Grim HEX</EM4> where we should be able to keep it on ice. 

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> at the very least. 

- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location1|Address]</EM4>
- Freight elevator at <EM4>[Location2|Address]</EM4>

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Title: Little Heavy Lifting at ~mission(Destination)
Description:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that have to be moved to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t. 

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a <EM4> handheld tractor beam</EM4> and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done. 

Stows out.

Title: Test Your Mettle
Description:
Heahunters are on the lookout for motivated and competent contractors who can be trusted to do a wide range of work supporting our operations. If you think you have what it takes, I’ve got a mission here that’ll test your skills in several ways. 

A [Ship] transporting cargo for us is currently under attack at [Location|Address]. Don’t think it’s looking good for our ship, but that cargo is too important to let fall into someone else’s hands. Need you to head to the location and deal with the attackers before they get away, then collect our cargo and take it to [Destination|Address]. 

If you can handle this, then there'll be lots more work I can send your way.  

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Destination) Errand
Description:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Title: Get the Good Stuff
Description:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location|Address] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to [Destination|Address]. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

Title: Headhunter Ship Needs Backup
Description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [Location|Address]. 

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me. 

- Stows out

Title: Return Goods
Description:
Just got a frantic comm from a [Ship] that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to [Destination|Address] was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at [Location|Address]. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Sent [TargetName] out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at [Location|Address], but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.

Title: Find ~mission(TargetName|Last)
Description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TargetName]. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction [Location|Address]. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

Title: Ghost some XenoTrash
Description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TargetName] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying around The cave can only be accessed on foot., so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

Title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
Description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [Location|Address] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

Title: Need a hitter
Description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [Location|Address]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

Title: Scrap Salvage at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

Title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
Description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to [Location|Address] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

Title: A Swift Reprisal
Description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in [Location|Address]. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.

Title: Need someone taken out
Description:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named [TargetName]. We've tracked them to  [Location|Address], so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you. 

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

Title: Anybody Seen ~mission(TargetName)?
Description:
I know better than to send someone like [TargetName] out by themselves, but that didn’t stop me from being a fool and doing it. Now the dumb SOB hasn’t returned my comms and nobody has set eyes on them in a few days.

If you got the time, I could use someone to go over to [Location|Address] and see if they’re still there. You get paid even if they wind up being dead.

-Stows

Title: Anybody Seen ~mission(TargetName)?
Description:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name [TargetName], to do a hand-off over at [Location|Address], but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows

Title: Kill Order
Description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TargetName], who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around The cave can only be accessed on foot., so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

Title: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TargetName]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying near The cave can only be accessed on foot. and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

Title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
Description:
I'm a bit at the end of my rope. I had sent [TargetName], a pretty dependable Headhunter, out to destroy the XenoThreat data servers at [Location|Address].

That was a while ago and I still haven't heard from them and the servers are still sitting there intact. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TargetName|NickOrFirst] and help finish destroying the servers.

-Stows out

Title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
Description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [Location|Address] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

Title: Get Our Shit!
Description:
Someone with a death wish attacked one of our ships hauling some primo product. Our crew on the scene is outta commission, so we need someone to get there fast and recover the stash before those bozos make off with it. Any chance you can handle this for us?  
  
Looks like the attack went down at [Location|Address]. Head over there and deal with the attackers before they get away. Then grab the goods from the [Ship] and take ‘em to [Destination|Address]. Oh, and don’t be an idiot and get high on that supply, unless you want me to send someone after you next. 

- Stows

Title: Search for Ship
Description:
Just lost contact with a [Ship] on an important run. Before they went dark, the crew was convinced someone was following them, so I’d put money on them being under attack. 

Looking for someone to get their ass over to [Location|Address] to search for the ship and retrieve the goods. If I’m right, there will be some uninvited guests hanging around that will need to be dealt with too. Once you’ve secured the stuff, it needs to go to [Destination|Address].   

You down to crack a few skulls and lug some cargo. Sounds simple enough, right? 

Stows out.

Title: Headhunter Pilot Needs a Hand
Description:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near [Location|Address]. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

Title: Simple Hit
Description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. [TargetName] is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to The cave can only be accessed on foot. and you should find [TargetName|Last] flying around. 

Stows out.

Title: Hit a CFP Ship
Description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named [TargetName|Last] who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around The cave can only be accessed on foot.. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

Title: Treat yourself to a fight
Description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named [TargetName] has been spotted flying around The cave can only be accessed on foot..

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

Title: Convince Upstarts to Abandon Sector
Description:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named [TargetName] who is operating out of [Location|Address]. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters. 

It's time to shut them down. 

Head over, take out [TargetName|Last] and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave. 

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

Title: Death and cargo
Description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to [Location|Address] where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back. 

Once you got the cargo, take it over to [Destination|Address] and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

Title: Need a death at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Need someone taken care of. They're holed up near [Location|Address]. Not sure if you care who they are, but their name's [TargetName]. Not much to tell, local thug who killed someone who was connected.

They've been on the run, so they're gonna be skittish. I'd approach with caution.

Stows out.

Title: Crash some ships
Description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [Location|Address] and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

Title: Knock Power Out
Description:
Got a few scavs that have rooted themselves into [Location|Address]. We have our own plans there and need the place cleared out. 

That's why I want you to ho and turn off their power. Let's see if that doesn't cause these rats to abandon the place for good.

-Stows

Title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
Description:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong. 

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at [Location|Address] and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

Title: Need a CFP taken down
Description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named [TargetName]. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty. 

Heard they're posted over at [Location|Address]. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

Title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
Description:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen. 

Head to [Location|Address] and destroy their data storage. 

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to The cave can only be accessed on foot.. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

If the credits seem right, head over and see if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last]. Just be careful. I’d hate to have to hire someone to find your body next.

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We’re on the market for a new stash house, so I sent [TargetName] over to The cave can only be accessed on foot.. They were supposed to just have a quick look and report back to me if any of the hangars would work for us, but I haven’t heard from them since.

My guess is that someone else was already using the hangar, but I’d sleep better knowing for sure.

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Some of my people were involved with a raid over at [Location|Address]. Most of them got out clean, but after the dust settled nobody is sure of what happened to [TargetName].

A lot of other gangs would just leave the poor bastard to rot, but that’s not the way the Headhunters do things. I want to know for sure if [TargetName|Last] is alive or dead and I’m willing to pay you good credits to find out.

Just be careful when you get there because I bet the assholes who live there are still gunning for a fight.

- Stows

Title: Deep space hit
Description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

Title: Target takedown for a fast track in
Description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named [TargetName] who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When [TargetName|Last] responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to [Location|Address] and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

Title: Shut Off Power at ~mission(Location)
Description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [Location|Address] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

Title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
Description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

[TargetName] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around The cave can only be accessed on foot., so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

Title: Gone But Not Forgotten
Description:
Not sure what happened, but a ship moving some important supplies across the system disappeared around [Location|Address]. Our crew at [Destination|Address] really needs that cargo for an upcoming operation. Any chance you could go looking for the ship and help complete the delivery?

Have no idea what happened, but my bet’s that they got ghosted. Maybe it’s just me, but I’d rather be a prepared pessimist and an ill-equipped optimist. 

- Stows

Title: Hauling ask.
Description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Ruin Station above Pyro VI</EM4> and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

Title: Deep space hit
Description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

Title: Target at ~mission(Location)
Description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [Location|Address] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TargetName] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TargetName|Last] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

Title: Shut Off Power at ~mission(Location)
Description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [Location|Address] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

Title: Primo Target
Description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TargetName] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TargetName|Last] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around The cave can only be accessed on foot., so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

Title: Hit on XenoThreat command
Description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [Location|Address] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

Title: Stop Rivals from Launching Heist
Description:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to [Location|Address] and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out

Title: Green light on ~mission(TargetName|Last)
Description:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named [TargetName] who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at [Location|Address] who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. [TargetName|Last] is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out [TargetName|Last], they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows

Title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
Description:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent [TargetName] to take out the some XenoThreat servers at [Location|Address] and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to them and make sure that those servers are destroyed for good.

-Stows out

Title: Unfinished Contract
Description:
Here's the deal, one of our usual heavy hitters, a cat named [TargetName], was sent to [Location|Address] to knock out some XenoThreat who'd been hiding there. We knew it was going to be a tall order, but that's why we called in [TargetName|Last]. Problem is, we ain't heard from them.

As far as we know XenoThreat are still operating out of that outpost so we gotta assume that [TargetName|Last] got popped. We need you to go in and finish what they started. Once that's done, if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last], that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
Description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TargetName] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around The cave can only be accessed on foot.. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Those XenoThreat assholes ambushed one of our outposts. We eventually kicked their ass out of there but once the cowards knew they'd been beat, they took [TargetName] hostage as a Human shield. We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at [Location|Address]. We need someone to break in, find [TargetName|Last], and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.

Title: Two Birds, One Stone
Description:
An informant passed along some interesting news. XenoThreat are about to do a massive ammo resupply run for their forces, and in preparation, they’ve brought all that cargo to [Location|Address]. Seems like a prime time to strike. You interested in killing a bunch of Xenos and then stealing their ammo for us?    

If so, get your shit in order and then clear that base. Once done, grab all the ammo and bring it to [Destination|Address]. You’ll get paid well, and I’m sure we’ll find something fun to do with all that ammo. 

Stows out.

Title: Get the Good Stuff
Description:
Need someone to raid a base at [Location|Address] for us. Not sure exactly who’s dug in there, but they attacked one of our ships and took the drugs they were hauling. Really need that shit back. That batch is full of high potency stuff that’s worth a premium. 

Doubt they’ll want to give it back to you, so plan to take it by force. Then bring the goods to [Destination|Address]. And don’t act like an idiot and get any ideas of what you could do with that stuff. Trust me, you don’t wanna get on my bad side. 

- Stows

Title: Headhunter Ship Needs Backup
Description:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at [Location|Address]. 

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me. 

- Stows out

Title: Return Goods
Description:
Just got a frantic comm from a [Ship] that cut out quite dramatically. Seems like they were dumb enough to get lured into a trap, even though I made it damn clear that getting those goods to [Destination|Address] was all they should worry about.   
 
Well, it looks like they failed. Trackers hidden in the cargo now show it at [Location|Address]. Time to send in backup to reclaim our goods and teach a lesson to those who took it. You interested in delivering that message then delivering the goods?

- Stows

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Sent [TargetName] out to check out a strange noise in one of our storehouses and haven't heard from them in a while. Turns out they got themselves kidnapped. We've got intel that says they're being held at [Location|Address], but we're not sure about the source. Need someone to swing by and make sure the info is legit.  

Whether it's good news or bad, there are some creds in it for you. 

Stows out.

Title: Find ~mission(TargetName|Last)
Description:
Last night, some no-name drifters threw down with our enforcers and ran when things got too hot. Didn't find out 'til they were long gone, but they made off with one of our Prospects when they split. Goes by the name of [TargetName]. 

Last we saw, they were headed in the direction [Location|Address]. We need someone to head there and track down our missing Prospect. 

If you take any of them down while you're at it, all the better.

Stows out.

Title: Ghost some XenoTrash
Description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named [TargetName] who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying around [Location|Address], so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

Title: Headhunter Pilot in Trouble
Description:
Just got word that a Headhunter over near [Location|Address] got roped into a fight and now they can't see it through. The idiot wants me to save their sorry ass.

Guess I'm a soft touch, because I'm actually going to pay you to do it for me. What do you say? Wanna save a moron's life?

-Stows

Title: Need a hitter
Description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near [Location|Address]. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

Title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson
Description:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves. 

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to [Location|Address] and really mess the place up. 

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out

Title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
Description:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life. 

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet. 

Go to [Location|Address] and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

Title: Hitting a CFP site
Description:
Need someone to sweep [Location|Address]. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge. 

Need it done fast and clean. 

Stows out.

Title: Shot in the chaos
Description:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake [Location|Address]. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by [TargetName] and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows

Title: Clear Citizens for Prosperity Servers
Description:
Long story, short - a Headhunter messed up real bad and now Citizens for Prosperity has gotten their hands on some data that could really do some damage to us. 

The bastard is going to need some time to heal so that leaves it to you to clean up the mess. Can you go to [Location|Address] and destroy the servers they got stored there? I wanna make sure there's no chance of this info getting out there.

-Stows out

Title: A little retaliation
Description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to [Location|Address] and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

Title: Scrap Salvage at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

Title: Scrap Salvage at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
A few days back I dispatched [TargetName|Last] to scope out a cave system for potential use as a storehouse. Haven't heard from them since. 

My gut tells me they ran into trouble. The local wildlife isn't known for being friendly, and [TargetName|Last] isn't exactly known for being cautious. If you're in need of some creds, I'm offering some up for anyone who can get in there and figure out what happened. 

Stows out.

Title: Anybody Seen ~mission(TargetName)?
Description:
I know better than to send someone like [TargetName] out by themselves, but that didn’t stop me from being a fool and doing it. Now the dumb SOB hasn’t returned my comms and nobody has set eyes on them in a few days.

If you got the time, I could use someone to go over to [Location|Address] and see if they’re still there. You get paid even if they wind up being dead.

-Stows

Title: Anybody Seen ~mission(TargetName)?
Description:
So, I sent one of our people, a new recruit by the name [TargetName], to do a hand-off over at [Location|Address], but now the bastard’s gone missing.

I’m thinking they either ran off with Headhunter credits and they’re good as dead, or they were robbed and now they’re lying there actually good as dead. Either way, I’d like for you to go have a look and see if you can find them.

If you settle the matter, I’ll give you what their cut would have been.

-Stows

Title: Scrap Salvage at ~mission(Location)
Description:
Need a hand taking care of some scrap at [Location|Address]. The team there put it all in one place but can’t be bothered to salvage it. Just clear it out for them to get some RMC and make some easy creds. 

- Stows

Title: Kill Order
Description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to [TargetName], who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around [Location|Address], so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

Title: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out [TargetName]. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that [TargetName|Last] was spotted flying near [Location|Address] and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

Title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
Description:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near [Location|Address] that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is [TargetName]. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.

Title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
Description:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around [Location|Address]. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts. 

We've also gotten word that [TargetName] is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up. 

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.

Title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
Description:
I'm a bit at the end of my rope. I had sent [TargetName], a pretty dependable Headhunter, out to destroy the XenoThreat data servers at [Location|Address].

That was a while ago and I still haven't heard from them and the servers are still sitting there intact. 

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to [TargetName|NickOrFirst] and help finish destroying the servers.

-Stows out

Title: Should'a left it to a professional
Description:
We had this kid named [TargetName] volunteer to go take out some XenoThreat near [Location|Address]. Everything we knew about the place said it was gonna be too much for [TargetName|Last] to handle, but they were real keen on boosting their standing with the Headhunters and thought this would do it, so they went alone.

Haven't heard anything but XenoThreat comms coming out of that place since. If you want to go and knock it over, we'll pay you instead. If you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last] that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

Title: Hit XenoThreat at ~mission(Location)
Description:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near [Location|Address]. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.

Title: XenoThreat Lieutenant needs some killing
