Description:
Hey if you’re reading this, we need a hand. An outpost of ours down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> got hit by a nasty storm and suffered some damage. None of our usual techs are available (or alive) to swing by so we wanna hire someone to go fix some fuses (no idea how many but <EM4>no more than three</EM4> I think). If you can bring a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough RMC canisters to sort out around three pipes</EM4>, we should be good.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Location) needs a bunch of repairs
Description:
Sending a call out to anyone nearby. Got a pretty heavy work order for one of our outposts at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Sounds like we need <EM4>six fuses</EM4> fixed. You'll also need a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4> with <EM4>enough RMC to patch up about five pipes</EM4> to stop the place from falling apart.

If you bring all the shit needed to patch them up, we'll pay you out.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Location) needs a bunch of repairs
Description:
Need somebody handy with tools to pop over to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and help out with some repairs. Our last repair guy knocked out most of the fixes but there's still some stuff that could use looking at.

I think if you've got <EM4>six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to patch up around five pipes</EM4>, you should be covered.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Location) needs massive repairs
Description:
Down at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, the place got utterly smashed in a storm and needs some serious patchwork.

If anyone out there has a <EM4>bunch of fuses</EM4> (I hear <EM4>six</EM4> should be plenty), a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC cans to deal with eight or so messed up pipes</EM4>, we'll hook you up with some creds to do the fix.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, the <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Location) needs massive repairs
Description:
The storms over at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.

Figure you'd need to bring <EM4>about six fuses</EM4>, a <EM4>salvaging tool</EM4>, and <EM4>enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes</EM4>. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.

Hell with this place.

Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that <EM4>“Guide to Maintenance”</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.

Stows out.

Title: Gone But Not Forgotten
Description:
Not sure what happened, but a ship moving some important supplies across the system disappeared around [Location|Address]. Our crew at [Destination|Address] really needs that cargo for an upcoming operation. Any chance you could go looking for the ship and help complete the delivery?

Have no idea what happened, but my bet’s that they got ghosted. Maybe it’s just me, but I’d rather be a prepared pessimist and an ill-equipped optimist. 

- Stows

Title: Hauling ask.
Description:
You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> to <EM4>Gaslight at the L2 Lagrange of Pyro V</EM4> and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry <EM4>4 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.  A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

Title: Deep space hit
Description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named [TargetName] and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find [TargetName|Last] around [Location|Address]. Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.

Title: Target at ~mission(Location)
Description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around [Location|Address] that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering [TargetName] who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that [TargetName|Last] is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

Title: Shut Off Power at ~mission(Location)
Description:
This is a fairly straightforward job. We got some assholes at [Location|Address] who have been thinking they're better than they are. Go and shut off their power to remind them that Headhunters are in charge.

-Stows out

Title: Primo Target
Description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. [TargetName] is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although [TargetName|Last] might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around [Location|Address], so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

Title: Hit on XenoThreat command
Description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at [Location|Address] to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

Title: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
Description:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent [TargetName] to take out the some XenoThreat servers at [Location|Address] and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to them and make sure that those servers are destroyed for good.

-Stows out

Title: Unfinished Contract
Description:
Here's the deal, one of our usual heavy hitters, a cat named [TargetName], was sent to [Location|Address] to knock out some XenoThreat who'd been hiding there. We knew it was going to be a tall order, but that's why we called in [TargetName|Last]. Problem is, we ain't heard from them.

As far as we know XenoThreat are still operating out of that outpost so we gotta assume that [TargetName|Last] got popped. We need you to go in and finish what they started. Once that's done, if you can find out what happened to [TargetName|Last], that would be a bonus.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
Description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So [TargetName] tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around [Location|Address]. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

Title: Track Down ~mission(TargetName)
Description:
Those XenoThreat assholes ambushed one of our outposts. We eventually kicked their ass out of there but once the cowards knew they'd been beat, they took [TargetName] hostage as a Human shield. We let 'em go, because we don't betray our own like that, but we're not planning on letting this stand. 

Word is that they fled to their base at [Location|Address]. We need someone to break in, find [TargetName|Last], and relay the info back to me. There's a lot of creds in it for you if you do the job right. 

Keep in mind this isn't their only outpost in the system. If they give you the slip, you may need to track them to another sector. 

Stows out.

Title: Two Birds, One Stone
Description:
An informant passed along some interesting news. XenoThreat are about to do a massive ammo resupply run for their forces, and in preparation, they’ve brought all that cargo to [Location|Address]. Seems like a prime time to strike. You interested in killing a bunch of Xenos and then stealing their ammo for us?    

If so, get your shit in order and then clear that base. Once done, grab all the ammo and bring it to [Destination|Address]. You’ll get paid well, and I’m sure we’ll find something fun to do with all that ammo. 

Stows out.

Title: Blow Up XenoThreat Fuel Reserves
Description:
It seems that XenoThreat has gotten the same intel we did and are looking to pull off the same job as us. 

I want you to knock the competition out of the picture. Go to [Location|Address] and take out the fuel tanks they got there.

Then my people can finish up without worrying about XenoThreat crashing the party.

-Stows out

Title: Reputation Management
Description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from [Location|Address]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

Title: Drop a XenoThreat
Description:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but [TargetName] is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around [Location|Address]. Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.

Title: Wipe Out XenoThreat Servers
Description:
Something just fell into my lap that is way too good to pass up. XenoThreat's intelligence gathering is a bit of legend in the circles I run in and it turns out that they're storing a whole heap of their best intel at [Location|Address].

Would be a shame if someone, say like you, were to go there and blow it all up, huh? 

-Stows out

Title: Go on the warpath
Description:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near [Location|Address]. Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Destination) Errand
Description:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along. 

Stows out.

Title: ~mission(Destination) Errand
Description:
Got a box sitting at <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> that needs to make its way over to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> would also be smart to bring along.

Title: Cull Irradiated Kopions
Description:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. 

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment. 

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Pest Control
Description:
There’s a growing <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> problem at <EM4>The cave can only be accessed on foot.</EM4>. Looking for a contractor to quickly and professionally take care of this infestation issue.  

For further details on the targeted creature, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Pest Control
Description:
A client has contacted us about resolving a <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> infestation issue before it gets any worse. Several locations around <EM4>The cave can only be accessed on foot.</EM4> are currently beset by the creatures. There’s a growing concern that if this goes on for too much longer, then the natural habit will be ravaged beyond repair. Are you available to take care of this issue?

You can refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specific information on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Reduce Overpopulation
Description:
We’ve been monitoring a situation at <EM4>[Location]</EM4> regarding an uptick in the <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> population over the past few months. Our models indicate that if this continues many of the native plants and animals will be adversely affected. It’s imperative that the <EM4>[Creature]</EM4> population is reduced before that happens.     

If you can help, please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for more specifics on the targeted creature.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Intensive Eradication Effort
Description:
Native plants and animals near <EM4>[Location]</EM4> are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.     

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Cull Invasive Creatures
Description:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near <EM4>[Location]</EM4>. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.  

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to <EM4>"The Guide to Stanton Wildlife"</EM4> in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.     

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Title: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
Description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
In going through the files, I’ve seen a couple of allusions to a specific lab sample that would potentially be useful to have our people analyze. Not sure where it is exactly, but if you hunt around Onyx Facility you should be able to find the sample and bring it to me.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Onyx Facility Research Wing</EM4> and <EM4>track down the Lab Sample</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Onyx Personnel Files
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary: 
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist <EM4>Dr. Logan Jorrit</EM4>. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions: 
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered <EM4>Onyx Facility</EM4> where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist.  Once there, locate and <EM4>access the research lab’s personnel files</EM4> so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there. 

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Engineering Files
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.

Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Research Files
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The files you found in Engineering confirm that Dr. Jorrit is actively pursuing something at the site, but it is still unclear what the doctor is up to. I’m hoping that if you can find the data he was accessing in Research it will provide further clarity.


Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing to locate and <EM4>access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files</EM4> .

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you accessed these files, I'll be sending you <EM4>5 Secure Drives</EM4> with copies of whatever data we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Retrieve Energy Anomaly Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
Reviewing Dr. Jorrit’s recent files that you uploaded to me left us with more questions than answers. While we know for a fact that the doctor had been inside Onyx, we don’t yet know the specifics of what he was doing. The client is eager for us to learn more about what exactly Jorrit’s up to, so I’m afraid you’re going to have to go back in.

I have a few ideas on how we might be able to use the facility’s systems to pinpoint Dr. Jorrit’s activities, though you’ll have to physically bring me the data this time so we can properly analyze it. First up, are the energy sensors in Engineering. They’re still active and sensitive enough to pick up any anomalous readings.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Energy Anomaly data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Energy Anomaly Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
It would be helpful to have the most recent energy anomaly data so that we can compare it to what you delivered last time. Any difference between the two data sets could prove useful.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Energy Anomaly data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Retrieve Security Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
We were able to pull some very interesting data from what you delivered, but we still don’t have a clear enough picture. What we did concretely learn though is that the Onyx security monitoring system is still operational. The data from there is going to be your next target.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Security data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Security Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
Out of an over-abundance of caution, it would be good to see if the security systems have picked up anything new since the last batch of data you delivered. That way we can make sure we’re up-to-date on what’s been happening down there.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Security data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Retrieve Seismic Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
Thanks to that last batch of data you delivered, we’re starting to fill in the gaps on what Dr. Jorrit’s doing down there. Got a rough timeline of his activities. Seems he’s had more stuff coming into Onyx than going out which is interesting. We’re going to need more intel though. There’s an old experiment running down there that monitors minute seismic changes. If you can deliver that data to me, it’ll help us pinpoint some of the movement around the facility.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Seismic data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address].</EM4>

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Seismic Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
One of the biggest issue when it comes to ongoing investigations is intel growing stale. To help alleviate that, I’m going to have you head back into Onyx and grab the latest seismic sensor data. Would be good to see what the latest readings say.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Seismic data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

Title: Jorrit Dossier: Power Usage Data
Description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:

Title: Hunt the Polaris
Description:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

This is a call to arms for all available Civilian Defense Force volunteers. An RSI Polaris corvette on its way to Invictus Launch Week festivities has been hijacked by the terrorist organization the Frontier Fighters. SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

Title: In the Wake of Disaster
Description:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near [Location] that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.
 
I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield. 

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

Title: Ling Shipment Recovery
Description:
Hello,

Looking for a quick job? Got a client who's waiting on a shipment but our hauler ran into some engine trouble. Can't seem to get them up and running so we need someone to take over.

Fly out to <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4> and you'll spot their ship. You can't miss it - it's the one that's sitting still in the middle of space. Make sure you bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> along with a decent ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Once you've picked up the goods take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

Thanks,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling 







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Title: Complete Stranded Ling Shipment
Description:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can carry <EM4>32 SCU cargo containers</EM4>.

Title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
Description:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at [Location] and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard. 

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters. 

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy. 

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Title: ~mission(Contractor|PrisonerBreakTitle)
Description:
Here’s the deal - A couple of long timers got snagged pulling a job for me and I want you to spring them. 

A friendly mechanic has arranged for their prison transport to run into some trouble en route, venting the front door and bringing the ship to a halt. You’re gonna go, dispatch any security escorting the transport, find the prisoner manifest aboard, and use it to locate my crew’s cryopods.

The popsicles I’m after are [NameSave2], [NameKill1], [NameSave3], and [NameSave1]. All have been loyal and deserve better than rotting in jail.

At least I think they've been loyal... I'm still wondering how they got pinched in the first place. I can't shake the feeling that one of them may have been doubling dealing. Tell you what, if you find any proof that one of my crew has been working with the Advocacy, liquidate their cryopod and I’ll see you get a bonus. 

Once you've activated the right pods and my people are starting to thaw, get the hell out of there and let the retrieval team handle the rest. This last bit is important. See, once they’re defrosted, they're gonna be sent off to retirement. No sense in them knowing any more about my business than they already do, i.e. I don’t want these lunks seeing your face or even knowing you exist. 

Once you’re back on your way, I’ll send you a hefty pile of well deserved creds.

Now just in case you’re getting any ideas along the lines of “Why don’t I just free everyone?” or “Wouldn’t it be easier to shut them all up permanently?” Forget it. The politics of this whole thing is more complicated than you need to know. Just trust me when I say that if any extra prisoners get freed or die without me ordering it, you’ll be the one who pays. Want all your money? Do what you’re told and that’s it. 

-Twitch

Title: Steal Subsidies
Description:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them. 

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid [Pickup1|Address] and claim the [item] for the cause. Once you deliver everything to [Dropoff1|Address] we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them. 

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em. 

Comm. Spec. Engler

Title: Repossess Supplies
Description:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system. 

That shipment was delivered to [Pickup1|Address]. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the [item], and take it to [Dropoff1|Address] so we can properly dispose of it. 

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

Description:

Title: Interested in Building a Better Future?
Description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond. 

A research initiative at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Title: Additional Resources For Research
Description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem

Title: Vital Resources Needed For Research
Description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: <EM4>saldynium, jaclium, and carinite</EM4>.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Description:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments. 

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.      

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

Title: Collect Irradiated Valakkar Eggs
Description:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are working day and night to solve the current regen crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need rare resources that the company's suppliers cannot deliver.

Our scans have confirmed several radioactive storms with known a valakkar presence on Pyro I, you can find a shuttle near <EM4>[Location]</EM4> that will take you inside the storm. Title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
Description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Title: Cargo Transfer from Shuttered Facility
Description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL 
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS' 
----------------------------    

ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>, still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.

You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to <EM4>32 SCU</EM4> in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to <EM4>Teasa Spaceport</EM4>. 

Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness.  And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along. 

BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'

PICK UP

DROP OFF

Title: Red Wind Easy Cargo Recovery
Description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

Title: Red Wind Challenging Cargo Recovery
Description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

Description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously. 

EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.

Title: Red Wind Special Cargo Recovery
Description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.

Title: Red Wind Dangerous Cargo Recovery
Description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> are highly recommended.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>[Location|Address]</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>

The cargo should be in the bay of the abandoned ship. The client has already expressed frustration regarding the cargo’s delay so please work quickly and efficiently.

BE RESILIENT – Life is hard and sometimes you have to roll with the punches. Keep going and don’t let it bring you down.

Title: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
Description:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

Title: URGENT: Retake Security Post Kareah
Description:
Security Post Kareah is under attack by an unknown number of assailants. 

Crusader is seeking contractors to quickly travel to the station and eliminate all trespassers in the vicinity before our security forces are overwhelmed.  

We’re not sure whether the attackers are targeting the contraband in our evidence lockup or our CrimeStat database, but whatever they’re after, they need to be dealt with. You will receive a combat bonus for each target neutralized.  

By accepting this contract, you agree to abide by all Crusader Security protocols: If you harm any guards or other authorized contractors while on the station, your contract will be terminated and you will be marked as a target. 

Time is of the essence, but make sure you’re well equipped to handle the hostiles before responding. 

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY: 
Liaison Officer Bautista 
ID# 948J030K

Title: limited supply
Description:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

Title: inventory clear out
Description:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

Title: out of stock
Description:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to [Location|Address] and destroy all the drugs on site. 

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

Title: too many cooks
Description:
A client is getting out produced by a new competitor and is looking to throw a wrench into the works.

You’re going to head to [Location|Address] and kill all the civies who work there. 

Do what you want with the gun-toting goons guarding the workers, but remember that they aren’t the priority.

Title: good help’s hard to find
Description:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at [Location|Address], but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

Title: live and let an independent contractor deal out revenge
Description: Everybody holds grudges, right? I mean, when you get popped pulling a crime, I get that you’re a little sour, but that’s pretty much the game, right?

Title: makin’ a mess
Description:
This is a bit aggressive for my taste, but credits are credits, right?

Got a client who's looking for a highly motivated individual to head over to [Location|Address] and kill everyone who’s there. 

Basically, start shooting and don’t stop. You'll get paid once the site's clear.

Title: need an out?
Description:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat. 

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

Title: let's help each other
Description:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. 

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

Title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
Description:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refuelling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refuelling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: <EM4>make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out</EM4>.

A Club member has run out of fuel at <EM4>Asteroid Mining Base</EM4>. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of <EM4>[FuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Hydrogen</EM4> and  <EM4>[QTFuelRate] aUEC per SCU of Quantum </EM4>. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their <EM4>[Ship]</EM4> and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a <EM4>journal entry</EM4> on your mobiGlas called ""Refueling Protocols"" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates. 

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

Title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
Description:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
Your crew will need to gain access to a <EM4>QV Breaker Station</EM4>, collect the required <EM4>Sadaryx ore</EM4>, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4>.

This will require a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4> and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Title: Supply Order: Sadaryx Focus Lenses
Description:
CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using <EM4>Sadaryx crystals</EM4> and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a <EM4>Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment</EM4>.

Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at <EM4>[Destination|Address]</EM4> for processing.

Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

Title: XL Purchase Order: Hand Mined Materials
Description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>Nyx System </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for rare materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

There are only a few known locations where these materials can be sourced, mainly from now defunct Hathor Group sites on <EM4>Daymar and Aberdeen</EM4>. Our suggestion would be to head to the Platform Alignment Facilities (PAF) and attempt to reactivate their Orbital Laser Platform (OLP) to access the materials below the planet's surface.

Reminder, since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>[Hint_Tool]</EM4>.

Title: Hide Snow Suit
Description:
You want be hidden. Wikelo understand. Not ask questions why. But what do when you in snow? Wikelo have suit for that.

Welcome.

Title: Snow Snipe
Description:
Want to shoot long away and stay hiding. But it snowing? Wikelo have gun for you.

Bring things. I give.

Bye.

Title: Make glowy armor
Description:
Wikelo had exciting idea during brief work rest. Was thinking about the little glow worms in Pyro and saw armor get changed to look like.

If you get me parts, bring to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and will make for you then you can glow too.

Bye.

Title: Make VOLT shotgun angrier
Description:
You feel like gun not angry enough? VOLT shotgun very powerful, very dangerous, but not scary? Bring to me. Can make very scary and angry.

They respect you then. Bring to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and we make.

Bye.

Title: Test Armor
Description: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.

Title: Curious Weapon
Description:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.

Title: Turn Things to Favor
Description:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out <EM4>favors</EM4>, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and will trade for favor.

Bye.

Title: Trade Council Scrip for Favors?
Description:
If you want other way to get <EM4>favors</EM4> from Wikelo, have thing for you. Wikelo have need for <EM4>scrip</EM4> given out by Council group. Wikelo not part of thief souli, but has business from time to time.

If you bring scrips to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>, will trade for favor.

Bye.

Title: Trade Worm Parts for Favors?
Description:
Have new way to get <EM4>favors</EM4> from Wikelo. Hear much about worm things in radiation storms. Made up of many interesting parts that Wikelo find use for. 

If you bring parts to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>, will trade for favor.

Bye.

Title: Trade Merc Scrip for Favors?
Description:
Wikelo has another way to get <EM4>favors</EM4> if you interested. 

Your Mercenary souli has <EM4>scrip</EM4> metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>, will trade for favor.

Bye.

Title: Want Polaris? Need something special.
Description:
Wikelo need large amounts of <EM4>quantainium</EM4> and is willing to give you nice Polaris in exchange but also know many humans not have much space, so you trade as you go. Wikelo will you <EM4>Polaris bits</EM4> if you want trade quantainium. Work like favors. Help Wikelo remember how much you give. 

Bring quantainium to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and will trade for bits.

Bye.

Title: Very Hungry
Description:
You humans keep Wikelo very busy. Work more than when I at old souli. But Wikelo very hungry now and can't get food.

Please help. Bring food and drink to Wikelo Emporium at <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>.

Very appreciate your help. Will give thing in return.

Bye.

Title: Red Fight Shotgun
Description: Shooting can be messy. Red Human Blood everywhere. Not a problem with this shotgun. Splashes blends right in! I give it to you if you give me everything I want on list. Good trade.

Title: Wikelo Arrive to System
Description:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>.

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.

Title: Your Best Shot
Description: This rifle is very good at shooting, but could have nicer design. Wikelo fix. Looks very nice now. Give to you for trade. Bring me things, I give you rifle. Even give you blueprint if you need.

Title: Hot Shot
Description:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.

Title: Shiny Builder Suit
Description: You need utility suit. Good for work. If you like, Wikelo can make shinier. Look real good. See what Wikelo need and bring.

Title: Do Lava Suit
Description: If you have armor, Wikelo can make it look warm. Good look for useful armor. Bring me things and will do.

Title: Armor with horn and string
Description:
Hello, know many humans want saldynium for regen problem. Credits good, yes, but Wikelo can use that, kopion horn, and other things to make special armor. 

Once done, you be very tough. Very scary.

You see items needed. Bring to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and I make for you.

Bye.

Title: Fun Kopion Skull Gun
Description:
Hello. Can make fun change to gun if you want. Use kopion skin for pattern and little skull dangle. Very effective. Shoot much better.

All you need is bring me parts to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and will make. 

Bye.

Title: Fun Military Skull Gun
Description:
Hello. Can do version of gun if you kopion soldier. Make material like soldier camouflage but with dead skull on front. Gun shoot better too.

If want, bring part to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> and will make.

Title: Red Fight Armor
Description: Wikelo hear that Humans think red is the color of passion and anger. This armor good for both. You give me items on list and this red armor is yours.

Title: Yormandi Gun
Description: This gun has picture of amazing creature on side. Use it and it make you big and strong like Yormandi. Spit lightning. Bring my items and then you get it. Bye.

Title: Armor with Vanduul
Description:
Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.

Bring things. Will do.

Bye.

Title: Red Fight Apollo
Description: Apollo very good ship. Would be much better if ship was red. Wikelo make all things possible. You trade for what I want and we have a deal.

Title: Make ATLS shoot
Description:
Hello. Know you human like strange metal suit. How about metal suit with ikti? Sorry, ikti is Banu word, you call it 'gun.' 

If want, bring things I say and I will make for you. Gun will shoot. Cause many damage.

Bye.

Title: Make jumpy ATLS shoot
Description:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4>. Will make.

Wikelo

Title: Noxy Mod
Description: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.

Title: Pulse Plus
Description: Wikelo really like this little Human ship. Pulse feel very fast. Can have many configuration to make Pulse go faster. If you want, can give you configurated Pulse that I like. Have list of what I want for job. Bye.

Title: Make a Ursa Mod
Description: Wikelo branching into ships too. Took a look at Ursa and improved. Bring parts for me and I will make for you. Explore planet better. Go do.

Title: Extra Special Wolf
Description: Wikelo very excited. Have idea for new material. But making it is most tricky. Very complicated. Need help fabricating a test sample. I give you blueprint, you make, bring to me, and I will trade. Give you extra special L-22 Wolf. Very powerful, very wolf.

Title: Asgard Fight Mod
Description: Wikelo mod Asgard and so that it fights more. You in a fight, this mod is what you want. Plus, good deal on the trade. Just bring items here and I give you the ship.

Title: Want Taurus ship
Description: Wikelo came across plans to build Constellation Taurus ship. Nice ship, but Wikelo make a little better. Prettier too. If you want, bring stuff.

Title: Starlifter A2 War Mod
Description: Bring Wikelo the things and I make you A2 Starlifter that fights better. Does war so good make you call it A1! Bye.

Title: F8 War Mod
Description: Can make you custom of F8 that take good fighting ship and make a better fighting ship. Bring things and I will make. Bye.

Title: Sneaky Stabber
Description: Have the pieces to build useful ship for people who like to sneak then fight. Take F8C ship and make even better. Have put what Wikelo will need to build for you. Now you decide. Bye.

Title: Prowler More Utility
Description: Wikelo work hard. You work hard. Prowler Utility work hard. But you bring me right items, I make it work more hard, then you work less hard. Bye.

Title: More than a Max
Description: If you want to move many things. Hercules ship, very good for that. Wikelo even know souli back in Protectorate that started to use. Very big. Wikelo can give you similar version if you get what Wikelo need. Look at list and tell me.

Title: New Move Big Starlancer Ship
Description: If you like big space to move things, Wikelo can do useful and wonder things to MISC ship for you. Bring me pieces and I will give you version even better than what Xi'an can do.

Title: Wikelo Navy F7
Description: Know how much you Humans like Navy so Wikelo have one now. If you want Wikelo version of F7 mk2, bring me things and you are in. Very funny. Bye.

Title: Firebird Mod
Description: Been digging into Aegis Sabre ship. Firebird is very bomb-y. Good build but could make some fun change to it. If you want, I can do. Have a look and tell me. Bye.

Title: Guardian Fight Mod
Description: This ship look like insect in the Protectorate. Fun look. Painful sting. Wikelo can make custom version for you if you want. Make enemies sting. Bye.

Title: Guardian WiK-X
Description:
You Humans enjoy strange letter combinations. It very funny. Guardian ship very useful but if you want even more useful, bring me things. I give you better ship. Look better. Act better.

Thank you. Bye.

Title: Guardian take down ship
Description: Insect ship again. This one help take down other ship but if you want it to take down better. Can make. See list and tell Wikelo. Bye.

Title: Peregrine Wikelo Mod
Description: Wikelo not want to race but can still make fast ship faster. If you want, bring me things, and go faster.

Title: Build a Mod Scorpius
Description: Don't know what the name mean, but ship is very fast, very good in fight. With tweak, can better. You see list of what Wikelo need, go get and I make. Bye.

Title: Spirit Cargo mod
Description: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.

Title: Starfighter Inferno Special
Description: Starfighter Inferno good ship, but what if you want it to be better ship at fighting? Wikelo knows just what to do. You bring me the items and I make it for you. Bye.

Title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
Description: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.

Title: What is Terrapin?
Description:
Wikelo not know this Human word but ship is very useful when things go danger. If you want, can give new version of it. Maybe more useful?

You fly and tell. Bye.

Title: Zeus Cargo Special
Description: Wikelo can make new version of cargo Zeus ship. If you want, bring what needed, then you can have ship. Fair. Bye.

Title: Zeus Special
Description: Wikelo can make new version of Zeus ship. I know it important ship to Human. Not sure why, but yes, very useful ship. Anyway, can upgrade and make a little prettier. What I need listed, if you want, bring. Bye.

Title: Now make Polaris. Short Time Deal.
Description:
Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship. 

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bring to <EM4>[destination|ListAll]</EM4> if want.

Bye.

Title: Ready for RAFT?
Description: RAFT is very useful. Wikelo take it and make it very very useful. Do work and make you happy. You want? Bring items to Wikelo for trade.

Title: Golem Rocks
Description:
Universe need resources so Wikelo always respect people who dig. Good profession. If you starting and want boost to Golem ship. I can do. 

Bring. 

I make.

Title: Fortune ship for you
Description: Hello, practicing on making ship fly better. Xi'an help human make ship. Fly good. Salvage good. But Wikelo can make better if you want. Bring things and will do. Bye.

Title: Upgrade Intrepid
Description: If you are looking for Intrepid ship that more intrepid. Wikelo can help. Bring things and you will get special touches on ship by Wikelo and pretty new coat to it. Bye.

Title: Where Wolf? Here Wolf
Description: If you want to be quiet and surprise people, this is the Wolf you want. Wikelo mod it to be extra stealth. Trade you for it when you bring me the items I want.

Title: Most Special Wolf
Description: You have been good trade partner for Wikelo. Offer you this very special Wolf mod. Make trade even better - Bring me what I want and I give you the special Wolf AND Antium Armor AND a VOLT LMG. Very good deal for my very good customer.

Title: Prospects Look Good
Description: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.

Title: RSI Meteor Mod
Description:
Meteor big. It heavy. Have many guns. But Wikelo figure out way to make even better. You have things I will take to do.

That is all.

Title: Special Idris For Killing
Description: Since Wikelo has done good business with you, make you this very special trade. Idris is a powerful ship perfect for big important person like you. Wikelo has even done mod to make it more dangerous! Bring me a few items and the ship is yours.

Title: Suit Up Take Off
Description: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.

Title: ATLS Orange Line
Description: Many Human work place have orange color there. Must mean work to you. This suit does work. Make sense.

Title: ATLS Cool Metal Color
Description: Wikelo give deep red and green colors to make ATLS legs look like they cooling from heat. Very pretty.

Title: ATLS Snowland Color
Description: Wikelo travel to one Human planet and find very cold, but very pretty. This remind of that.

Description:

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space.

Title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
Description:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with Area18 and take you to visit Cubby Blast, a weapons store here in Area18.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

Description:

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

Title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #1
Description:
If travelling to different star systems around the Empire, helping those in need, and protecting our borders sounds like a rewarding career to you, then maybe you’re ready to become a pilot in the UEE Navy.

The overall demand for naval pilots has increased in recent years which means there’s now more opportunity than ever before. However, to become a Navy pilot, you need to go through specialist training and gain many hours of flight experience.

To give you a small taste of what life as a combat pilot would be like, Gilly’s Flight School has partnered with the UEE Navy to offer a unique opportunity to take a special Patrol Training course that will run you through three scenarios covering a basic patrol. 

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #1 – Scanning a Patrol Point</EM4>

I believe that folks learn best by doing, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding out there. This is about throwing you into the deep end and giving you a chance to swim. You never know what you’re capable of until you’re given the chance.

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip. Plus, completing all three will get you a special keepsake.

Can’t wait to see you out there,
Instructor Gilly


ABOUT GILLY FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

Title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #2
Description:
Congrats on completing part one of this three-part course.

For your next patrol scenario, things are going to become even more intense.

Be prepared to encounter some hostiles and dogfight them in a realistic combat scenario just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol.

The hostile ships are all specially equipped rigs made specifically for training purposes and will be piloted by graduates of the flight school to provide an engaging and educational experience.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #2 – Neutralizing a Hostile Threat</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip.

Make sure you pick a ship ready for combat and I’ll see you out there,
Instructor Gilly

Title: Navy Patrol Training – Scenario #3
Description:
Congrats on completing part two of this three-part course.

For your next and final lesson, you will learn how to assist a ship in distress just like real Navy pilots do while out on patrol. They will be under simulated attack by our specially trained hostile pilots and it will be up to you to neutralize them as quickly and effectively as possible.

<EM4>SIGN UP NOW FOR SCENARIO #3 – Ship in Distress</EM4>

As a bonus on completion of the scenario, the original contract holder will be awarded [ScripAmount] MG Scrip and a special keepsake.

I know you’re going to do great out there,
Instructor Gilly

Title: Happy Invictus
Description:
Hello Citizens and Civilians,

The United Empire of Earth is proud to acknowledge the start of this year's Invictus ceremony. Originally started in 2542, the United Planets of Earth dispatched Naval ships to each of the settled planets to pick up the latest group of volunteers entering military service.

Now, over four hundred years later, Invictus continues this proud tradition of celebrating those among us who are standing up for others and protecting the Empire as well as showcasing the latest additions to the Naval fleet.

This year's festivities can be found on <EM4>ArcCorp in Stanton</EM4> and feature a great hall with some of the newest ships on display as well as the new <EM4>Idris Experience Tour</EM4> where you can tour an active-duty Idris, accessible at the top of the IO-North tower.

Accept this contract if you would like guidance to the festivities. As a special thank you, in partnership with the Mercenary Guild, attendees will be awarded [ScripAmount] scrip.

Thank you and enjoy your Invictus.

Title: Easy Pickings
Description:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves? 

Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

57 65 65 76 69 6c

Title: XenoThreat = GoodLoot
Description:
You know who probably deserves taking down a peg or two? XenoThreat. 

We pulled some intel off a server that had details of all their upcoming operations, and for the right price, we could send you the exact coordinates of where an XT ship fully loaded with primo cargo is waiting. 

Here’s a little taste of what info we have so you know we’re not messing around. XenoThreat stashed the ship in a locked asteroid base hangar that can only be accessed via the station’s elevators. We can’t get the hangar doors open for you but have adjusted the security protocols so you’ll be able to use a console in the hangar to override the lockdown.  

Interested?

57 65 65 76 69 6c

Title: Goods for the Getting
Description:
You'd figure that if people were planning a big heist they wouldn't leave all the details laying around spectrum where just about anybody could hack them? 

But hey, their loss is your gain. Currently, a cargo-heavy ship is locked down in the hangar of an asteroid base. Only way to access it is via the station’s elevators. Once inside, you’ll be able to use a console to override the lockdown to get everything out of there. We’ll happily sell you the coordinates, but the rest is up to you. 

Guess their loss will be our gain too.

Title: A Chance to Impress
Description:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives. 

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim. 
 
If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills. 

Seek out and discreetly kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address].

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Title: Another Chance to Impress
Description:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more. 

Kill [TargetName] over at [Location|Address] and I will consider the slate wiped clean. 

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Title: A Well Deserved Break
Description:
I've been having a hard time tracking this target down. They're part of a gang known as the Claw Salamanders who tend to be quite itinerate. However, it seems the group has been trying to get an old QV Breaker Station operational again and I think this just may be the chance to take out [TargetName] once and for all. 

Start your search at [Location|Address].  These stations can apparently be quiet cavernous at  times so it may take a bit of effort to locate the target once you're on site.

However, I have all the confidence in your abilities,
Vaughn

Title: A Well Deserved Break
Description:
There is a member of the Nyx gang the Claw Salamanders, [TargetName], who has made it on to my naughty list. They had been on the run for quite awhile, but just recently popped back up at an old mining station in the Keeger Belt. Our lucky day shall be their last.  

Word is that you can find them at [Location|Address].  Unfortunately, there is a strong chance you may have to do some repairs to the station itself before you can gain access to that particular area.

But I'm sure you're more than up to the challenge.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

Title: A Well Deserved Break
Description:
A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one [TargetName], a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station. 

It is highly likely that you will find them at [Location|Address].  Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down. 

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn

Title: All Things Come To An End
Description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with [Location|Address], but [TargetName] is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

Title: They Will Be Missed
Description:
A senior security official by the name of [TargetName] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [Location|Address], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

Title: All Things Come To An End
Description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to [Location|Address] and kill [TargetName]. What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

Title: They Will Be Missed
Description:

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of [TargetName] which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
